# 04.2 Build a Semantic Blog Post

Use the content-level semantic elements to structure a complete blog post from scratch, choosing a topic you like (a favorite recipe, how you learned to code, travel tips).

**Your task:** complete `app.html` so the blog post is organized with `<article>`, `<section>`, and `<aside>`.

- Wrap the whole post in a single `<article>` with an `<h1>` for its title.
- Add **two** `<section>` elements inside the article, each with its own `<h2>` heading and at least one paragraph.
- Add one `<aside>` for related content, with a lower-level heading (such as `<h3>`) and a short paragraph or list.
- Nest everything correctly (article → sections + aside) and keep the heading hierarchy in order.

**Expected result:** the page renders a self-contained blog post whose inspected structure shows two themed sections and one aside nested inside a single article, with headings flowing h1 → h2 → h3.
